refnamediv.refpurpose: Perform a Lagrange Multiplier (LM) test for conditional heteroscedasticity.

listitem.para: Array-like. Dependent variable of the regression model.
Array-like. Independent variables of the regression model. If x is a scalar integer k, it represents the order of autoregression.
Integer. Number of lagged squared residuals to include in the heteroscedasticity model.
Float. p-value of the LM test.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function performs a Lagrange Multiplier (LM) test for conditional heteroscedasticity in a linear regression model: y = x * b + e The null hypothesis is no conditional heteroscedasticity, while the alternative is CH(p): y(t) = b(1) * x(t,1) + … + b(k) * x(t,k) + e(t), given y up to t-1 and x up to t, e(t) is N(0, h(t)) with h(t) = v + a(1) * e(t-1)^2 + … + a(p) * e(t-p)^2, and the null is a(1) == … == a(p) == 0. If the second argument is a scalar integer, k, perform the same test in a linear autoregression model of order k, i.e., with [1, y(t-1), …, y(t-k)] as the t-th row of x. Under the null, LM approximately has a chisquare distribution with p degrees of freedom and pval is the p-value (1 minus the CDF of this distribution at LM) of the test. If no output argument is given, the p-value is displayed.
